title: Plural of short -a words: -oja
summary: For these short -a words, replace -a with -oja: kirja (“book”) → kirjoja.
objectives: Form the plural partitive in this bounded word family.

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: A case is a word form used for a grammatical job. The dictionary form is the form used to look up a word. The partitive has several uses; it does not always mean “some”. Here you practise forming the word, so no sentence construction is required.

In these two-syllable words with a, e or i in the first syllable, replace final -a with -oja. A syllable is one beat of a word. Keep the consonants of the dictionary form, including strong consonants in hinta and silta. This is a selected word family, not a rule for every -a word.
keyPoints: Learn each word with its pattern; a similar final letter does not guarantee the same stem.

commonMistakes: Replace the final a; do not add -oja after it.
The koira family has a different plural pattern.
Keep nt in hintoja and lt in siltoja.
